[[File:Ramid_starship_space.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Ramid's starship in space]]
The [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Ramid]] owned a '''starship''' around [[139 ABY]]. The starship had a rounded rectangular shape and was equipped with three rear engines. That year, Ramid and his crew used their starship during a successful kidnapping attempt against his former lover [[Ania Solo]], who was wanted by the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]]. Feigning damage to their engine systems, they waited for [[AG-37's freighter]] to dock with them. During the meeting, Ramid arranged for Ania to be separated from her companions and then imprisoned her aboard his starship. He and his crew then made a cold jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], which consumed a large proportion of their fuel supplies.

While orbiting a barren planet which rained acid rain, they were attacked by a [[Unidentified masked bounty hunter|another bounty hunter]], who flew a modified [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]]. During the pursuit, Ramid's starship sustained extensive damage and the ship's [[Unidentified Twi'lek pilot|Twi'lek pilot]] was killed. Ramid then released Ania and convinced her to pilot and land the ship. Ania succeeded in landing Ramid's starship largely intact but Ramid was knocked unconscious during the landing. His [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Unidentified Klatooinian crew member|crew mate]] also perished during the accident. Shortly later, the mysterious bounty hunter demanded that Ania surrender herself. After sending a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] to tend to Ramid, Ania confronted the bounty hunter and succeeded in knocking her unconscious with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. She then fled into the wilderness.

Shortly later, Ramid awoke and left in a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] to rescue Ania. Ramid's ship had been damaged extensively during the crash and was unable to fly. Later, Ania's companions [[Jao Assam]], [[AG-37]], and [[Sauk]] found Ramid's starship. AG-37 found a lot of blood on the gangplank while Sauk found that the speeder storage section was empty.
